Manage Claude Code and Codex profiles

Usage: larp cc [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  app       Bind or open a verified desktop app (ChatGPT on macOS; Claude closed)
  skills    Manage explicit skill packages and per-profile sharing
  mcp       Manage reference-only MCP definitions and per-profile switches
  provider  Manage native provider bindings
  run       Launch a profile (qualification pending; disabled in this build)
  login     Authenticate a profile
  status    Show native authentication status
  logout    Log out a profile
  profile   Manage profile records (no login, no provider launch)
  alias     Manage root-bound alias commands (no PATH or shell edits)

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help

Data directory: $LARPCC_HOME if set, otherwise $XDG_DATA_HOME/larpcc or ~/.local/share/larpcc (Linux), ~/Library/Application Support/larpcc (macOS), %LOCALAPPDATA%\larpcc (Windows).
